tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: The logo's green, sampled from the mark. Logo, brand marks, large display accents (24px+), icons and the cover. On white it is 4.2:1, so never use it for body-size text in light theme; use `green-700` there.

tokens.name: brand-charcoal
tokens.usage: The logo's charcoal, sampled from the mark. Large numerals, secondary headings, logo lockups. 7.0:1 on `surface-100`.

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, links and inline emphasis. White text on it is 5.4:1 in light; in dark it takes `on-green` text (7.7:1).

tokens.name: green-800
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `green-700`.

tokens.name: green-100
tokens.usage: Quiet green ground: proof bar, selected chip, success notes. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `green-700` fills.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, forms, header, the mobile CTA bar.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Sunken bands and alternating sections, input fills on hover.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `surface-100`, `surface-0`, `surface-200` and `green-100` (14:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, source stamps, metadata on `surface-100` and `surface-0` (5.8:1 light, 6.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders (3.5:1 on `surface-0`), so controls stay visible without colour.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element. 4.6:1+ on every surface in both themes, including `green-100`.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Rating stars and the star glyph in proof stats. Always paired with the number (5.0), never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and failed submissions, always with an icon and a message.

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: Alias-like role for the WhatsApp CTA. Same value as `green-700` on purpose: one green family, no off-brand WhatsApp lime.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero H1 only. Archivo at width 112 (expanded) echoes the wide 3S letterforms. Drops to `display-l` under 640px.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page H1 on inner pages and landing pages.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: We upload, optimise and maintain your catalogue on Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, Etsy and eBay.
styles.usage: Hero sub-line and lead paragraphs. Max 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: He was very quick in getting my listings created for me.
styles.usage: Default running text and review quotes. Max 68ch.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Usually replies within about an hour

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and chips. Use sparingly: one per section at most.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Marketplace identifiers (ASIN, SKU, GTIN), the `checked 2026-11-20` source stamp, prices in tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, chip inner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, tight stacks, star row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, field label gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter, input padding, card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading block and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, marketplace tags, mono stamps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the proof bar, form panels, screenshots.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and the round WhatsApp button only.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards that sit on `surface-100`. Prefer the `line` border; add this only to the one card that should lift (featured work, the form).

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: Mobile sticky CTA bar and sticky header after scroll.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Normal page content.

tokens.name: z-sticky-header
tokens.usage: Sticky site header.

tokens.name: z-cta-bar
tokens.usage: MobileCtaBar, above content and header.

tokens.name: z-consent
tokens.usage: Cookie consent banner. It sits above the CTA bar and pushes it up while open.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Form success and error toasts.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every tap target.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page container.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for running text.
